title: Kosmos AI Scientist reads ~1,500 papers per run and reports seven discoveries
summary: Edison Scientific's Kosmos runs for up to 12 hours, coordinating data-analysis and literature-search agents through a shared world model to generate hypotheses and write cited scientific reports.
agent_role: Agents analyzed datasets, searched literature and drafted reports autonomously over a run; human scientists supplied the data and objective and evaluated the statements afterward.
outcome: About 200 agent rollouts, ~42,000 lines of code and ~1,500 papers read per run; independent scientists judged 79.4% of report statements accurate; seven showcased discoveries

curation.rationale: Launch seed collection, researched from search results.
